title: An HTTP Status Code for Indicating Hints
summary: This memo introduces the 103 status code, an informational HTTP status code that conveys hints to a client before the final response. The hints help the client begin preparing, for example by loading resources, while the server is still working on the full answer.

eli5.summary: While the server cooks the main meal, it hands over a quick note saying, you'll want a fork and a plate, so you can set the table.

questions: how to preload resources before the final response
